I searched San Francisco (SFO) to both Tokyo airports, Haneda (HND) and Narita (NRT), in business class for March 1 – May 31, 2027, at 90k points per seat or less. **There's plenty of space, and the best options are nonstop flights at 87k–88k.** The cheapest results overall are 85k, but they have a catch.

**Best options: nonstop, business class the whole way (36 flights in total)**

| Program | Flight | Route | Points / seat | Taxes | Dates with 2+ seats (of those shown) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Avianca LifeMiles | ANA NH9107, departs 1:25am | SFO → HND | 87,000 | $41 | Mar 26, Apr 8, Apr 24, May 7, May 23 (2 seats) |
| United MileagePlus | UA9837, departs 11:20am | SFO → NRT | 88,000 | $56 | Mar 3, Mar 17, Mar 24 (3 seats) |

- The LifeMiles/ANA flight has 1 seat on other dates too: Mar 16, Mar 22, Apr 7, Apr 10, Apr 19, May 5, May 10, May 19, May 20 and May 26. It flies to Haneda, which is the closer airport to central Tokyo.
- The search only displayed 20 of the 36 nonstops. The other 16 are mostly United flights to Narita in April (6) and May (10), so there are more dates than the table shows.

**Cheapest: 85,000 points through Air Canada Aeroplan (102 flights; 66 of them have 2+ seats)**
- These are one-stop trips on United plus ANA, leaving at 12:55pm, with about CA$101 in taxes. Space is available almost every day from March through May.
- **The catch:** they're labelled "mixed cabin." About 15% of the distance (probably a short connecting flight) is in a lower class than business. Saving 2–3k points probably isn't worth an extra stop and a partly non-business trip, so I'd go with a nonstop.

**Notes**
- All of this availability was seen about 2 hours ago. Award space changes quickly, so check the date on LifeMiles, United or Aeroplan before you transfer any points.
- How many people are travelling? You said "each," so I checked for 2 seats on the same flight, and there are plenty of options for 2. If you need 3 or more, the United nonstops to Narita are the most likely fit.
- I only searched one-way to Tokyo. Tell me your return dates and I'll search Tokyo back to SFO.
